HELPING AND SUPPORTING FAMILIES AFFECTED BY LEUKODYSTROPHIES

- Human support

- Support for respite care

For example, since 1994, ELA has invited all its member families to Center Parcs for a weekend each year. This is an opportunity for patientsand their familiesto exchange ideas, share and relax.

ELA's objective is to help French and international researchers  better understand the mechanisms of the disease and its natural history, particularly through the discovery of biomarkers, and to develop new treatments.
